esbuild.classification: development serve API; current project uses build/transform, not esbuild serve
esbuild.controlled_input: Browser/site or HTTP client to an explicitly started esbuild serve endpoint
trace: package.json db:generate → drizzle-kit → @esbuild-kit/esm-loader → @esbuild-kit/core-utils → esbuild0.18.20
Vite/Wrangler/tsx → esbuild transform/build0.27.3/0.28.0; no app esbuild serve call found
remaining_proof_gaps: Verify every esbuild context/serve caller in any supported developer command; no serving instance established
Windows traversal requires esbuild servedir; Vite dev is a different server, not proof of esbuild serve exposure

vite.classification: development HTTP middleware, not deployed renderer
vite.controlled_input: HTTP query file/path to Windows development server; attacker browser can target loopback for editor case

Vite node.js26331 installs launch-editor middleware;10419–10438 forwards file query to launch/path.resolve

remaining_proof_gaps: Editor UNC requires Windows/NTLM/SMB reachability; values not collected or tested
fs.deny advisory requires network exposure and NTFS/8.3 conditions; Public helper bindsloopback, supported Windows exposure not established
Host allowlist/loopback do not prove all browser-origin attacks impossible

ws.controlled_input: WebSocket peer frames; close-reason typed array for disclosure variant
ws.sink: ws Receiver fragmented-message buffering or Sender.close

No arbitrary typed-array reason call proven; e.reason type propagation needs checking
Do not equate Node ws with Workers native WebSocket or infer public production DoS

undici.classification: local runtime transport/HTTP tooling; advisory-specific optional APIs
undici.controlled_input: Upstream network/Set-Cookie/WebSocket peer or operator-configured SOCKS5/cache dispatcher
undici.sink: ProxyAgent/Socks5ProxyAgent, cookies parser, shared cache interceptor or WebSocket parser
trace: Wrangler/Cloudflare plugin → Miniflare → undici7.24.8
Miniflare index.js89217/89231 creates Pool to runtimeEntryURL/devRegistry; headers transport at77801/88468
Wrangler CLI contains proxy libraries, but bundled library definitions alone are not active configured calls
remaining_proof_gaps: Project no SOCKS5/cache/cookie-parsing/WebSocket undici configuration found; external supported tool/proxy options not exhaustively traced
Need exact cookie parse→forward path, shared authorized cache path or hostile outbound WS destination per advisory
Node built-in fetch is not automatically the pnpm undici package

js-yaml.controlled_input: YAML config document (potentially from a PR/dependency/config extension)
trace: eslint → @eslint/eslintrc → js-yaml4.1.1
@eslint/eslintrc dist/eslintrc.cjs2611/2620 loadYAMLConfigFile → yaml.load(readFile)
Current repository eslint.config.mjs is flat JS, not YAML; legacy/extended configs and supported alternate inputs require review
remaining_proof_gaps: Actual YAML parse invocation for this flat-config command and untrusted document path not established
Untrusted PR JS can already execute code; risk must be scoped to bounded credential-free runner rather than assumed new prod privilege

@babel/core.controlled_input: Attacker-supplied sourceMappingURL in source compiled by Babel, with output visible
trace: Next→styled-jsx; eslint-config-next→react-hooks; plugin compiler path → @babel/core7.29.0
normalize-file.js67 allows inputSourceMap unless false;86 reads external referenced source map
No Public route compiles submitted source; future CI may process untrusted PR source
remaining_proof_gaps: Which build/lint caller invokes Babel compilation and its inputSourceMap options must be traced
CI secrets-free ephemeral filesystem reduces consequences but does not fix vulnerable package
Whether generated map output is exported to attacker not established

brace-expansion.controlled_input: Untrusted pattern string from config/glob inputs or PR-controlled config

1.1.14 index.js38/54 parseCommaParts recursion;103 expand;126 recursive members
No request-driven glob construction in app/lib/components found
remaining_proof_gaps: Exact externally supplied pattern reaching each caller/alternate version not fully traced
Default pattern caps may not defeat advisories; do not execute exhaustion payloads
Build/CI lower-trust source and timeout limits, not Public request parsing, determine practical impact

braces.controlled_input: Glob pattern from config/PR or tool input
trace: eslint-plugin-next→fast-glob→micromatch→braces3.0.3
vinext→vite-plugin-commonjs→vite-plugin-dynamic-import→fast-glob→micromatch→braces3.0.3
No HTTP/route pattern input in Public app found
remaining_proof_gaps: Trace pattern origin/control into fast-glob for both parent paths
No upstream patched version currently declared; parent replacement/constraint proposal separate from this local preparation

source-map-js.controlled_input: CSS sourceMappingURL or explicit prior indexed map controlled by build input

postcss/lib/previous-map.js24 loadMap;34 new SourceMapConsumer;100 reads map;133 decodes inline annotations
source-map-js consumer.js14/21 selects IndexedSourceMapConsumer; app has no uploaded source-map route

Public artifacts server maps are diagnostic output, not a parser endpoint; do not infer runtime exposure

Actual Linux CI libvips/librsvg linkage and input provenance must be established before native-image tests
Fix candidate0.35.5 needs separate dependency-change authorization/compatibility verification
